gaps.quote: Write each integer as a polynomial in $2^b$ whose coefficients are its digits.
gaps.note: The page never says what b denotes in 2^b. Earlier b was bound to the second coefficient list b(x), so the reader cannot tell the digit-width parameter the integer construction needs, and cannot check that the digits are the coefficients of a polynomial in 2^b.

gaps.quote: Its coefficients stay bounded, so carrying them in base $2^b$ reads the integer off.
gaps.note: The page asserts that the coefficients of the product stay bounded but gives no bound and no condition on S or b relating the slot width to the digit size and list length, so the reader cannot check that carrying recovers the integer.
